segments.name: the development of the Project
segments.description: Development-stage company developing the Project to extract and refine borates, calcium co-products and potentially lithium carbonate for industrial customers.
segments.evidence: The Company has evaluated how it is organized and managed and has identified only one reportable business segment, which is the development of the Project.

revenueModel.text: The company has no revenue yet and plans to sell boric acid and other products to industrial customers under offtake agreements that are not yet binding.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company currently generates no revenue from operations and will need to rely on raising additional capital or 88 financing to sustain current and planned operations in the long term.
